html:
Northside Coffee Co. · 2026-10-22 → 2026-10-28

Refund rate spiked 44.2% despite total revenue growing 4.9%.

Weekly revenue rose 4.9% to $21,734.83, driven by a strong peak of $4,807.30 on October 25 and an 8.3% increase in new customers. However, conversion rate slipped 3.4% to 3.33%, and the refund rate rose sharply to 2.88%. We need to address quality control immediately while maintaining customer acquisition momentum.

Revenue$21,735▲ 4.9%
Orders515▲ 3.2%
Average order value$42▲ 1.6%
New customers208▲ 8.3%
Conversion rate3.3%▼ 3.4%
Refund rate2.9%▲ 44.2%

Wins

  • Revenue grew 4.9% to $21,734.83, capped by a high of $4,807.30 on October 25.
  • New customer growth increased 8.3% to 208 (up from 192).
  • Orders increased 3.2% to 515, lifting Average Order Value 1.6% to $42.20.

Watch

  • Refund rate jumped 44.2% from 2% to 2.88%, eroding net profits.
  • Conversion rate dropped 3.4% down to 3.33% from 3.45%.
  • Mid-week sales dropped significantly, bottoming at $2,319.11 on October 23.

Do this week

  1. Audit all customer return logs from the past week to pinpoint the root cause of the 44.2% refund spike.
  2. Review the marketing and store traffic from October 25 to see how to replicate the $4,807.30 daily revenue peak.
  3. Inspect the checkout user experience to recover the 3.4% loss in conversion rate.
